title: Management Consultant Salary: Hourly to Annual, Fortnightly, Tax and Super Guide
description: Calculate a management consultant salary from hourly rates using a 38-hour week, 52-week year. Includes tax, super, and award rates from Fair Work and ABS.
salarySummary: A management consultant on $60 per hour working 38 hours a week earns $118,560 annually before tax, with super paid on top.

faqs.q: What is the average management consultant salary in Australia?
faqs.a: The Australian Bureau of Statistics reports average full-time adult ordinary time earnings of $2,083.70 per week (May 2026), but management consultant salaries vary widely by experience and firm. The Jobs and Skills Australia profile notes that 79% of management consultants work full-time, with average full-time hours of 43 per week, and the median age is 42. Actual salaries often exceed the national average due to specialised skills.

faqs.q: Are management consultants covered by an award?
faqs.a: Many management consultants are award-free and rely on the National Minimum Wage as a floor ($26.44 per hour from 1 July 2026). Some may fall under the Professional Employees Award 2020 if their role involves professional engineering, scientific, or IT duties. Always check your specific employment contract or enterprise agreement. The Fair Work Ombudsman provides pay guides for applicable awards.

faqs.q: How do I calculate my annual salary from an hourly rate?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours worked per week, then by 52. For a standard full-time role, assume 38 hours per week. For example, $60 per hour × 38 hours × 52 weeks = $118,560 per year. To get fortnightly pay, multiply your weekly pay by 2. Remember that superannuation (12%) is paid on top of your ordinary earnings, and tax is deducted using the 2026–27 resident rates.

bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding the management consultant salary landscape

Management consultants help organisations improve efficiency and solve problems. Their pay can vary significantly based on experience, firm size, and location. According to the Jobs and Skills Australia profile, 79% of management consultants work full-time, with average full-time hours of 43 per week. However, for standard salary calculations, a 38-hour week is the benchmark used by the Fair Work Ombudsman and the Australian Bureau of Statistics.

The National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour ($1,004.90 per week for 38 hours). Casual employees receive a 25% loading, bringing the rate to $33.05 per hour. Most management consultants earn well above these minimums, but the award-free nature of the role means the National Minimum Wage acts as a legal floor.

### Using the ABS average weekly earnings as a benchmark

The Australian Bureau of Statistics reports that full-time adult ordinary time earnings averaged $2,083.70 per week in May 2026. This equates to an annual salary of approximately $108,352 (before tax). Management consultant salaries often exceed this average due to specialised skills and experience. The median age for management consultants is 42, and 41% of the workforce is female.

## Calculating annual pay from an hourly rate

The formula is straightforward: **hourly rate × hours per week × 52 weeks**. For a standard full-time employee, we assume 38 hours per week. If you work more hours, those extra hours may be unpaid or attract overtime rates, but for simplicity, this calculation uses the same rate every week.

**Example:** A management consultant earning $60 per hour working 38 hours per week:
- Weekly pay: $60 × 38 = $2,280
- Fortnightly pay: $2,280 × 2 = $4,560
- Annual gross pay: $2,280 × 52 = $118,560

If you are a casual employee, your hourly rate typically includes a 25% casual loading. For instance, a casual management consultant on a base rate of $60 would receive $75 per hour (including loading). Do not add the loading again if your rate already includes it. Use the [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) guide for more details.

### Why 38 hours?

The Fair Work Ombudsman uses 38 hours as the standard full-time week for the National Minimum Wage and most modern awards. Even if you work 43 hours (the average for management consultants), the 38-hour week is the standard for standardised salary comparisons. Use the [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) tool to adjust for your actual hours.

## Tax and superannuation

From the 2026–27 financial year, the Australian Taxation Office applies these resident tax rates:
- $0 – $18,200: nil
- $18,201 – $45,000: 15%
- $45,001 – $135,000: 30%
- $135,001 – $190,000: 37%
- $190,001+: 37%
- Medicare levy: 2% (single reduction thresholds not confirmed for 2026–27; use 2025–26 single thresholds for estimates).

**Example tax estimate for $118,560 annual gross:
- Tax on $118,560: $18,200 × 0% + ($45,000 – $18,200) × 15% + ($118,560 – $118,560) × 30%? Let's compute: $18,200 × 0% = $0; $45,000 – $18,200 = $26,800 × 15% = $4,020; $118,560 – $45,000 = $73,560 × 30% = $22,068; total tax = $26,088. Plus Medicare 2% of $118,560 = $2,371.20. Total tax and Medicare = $28,459.20. Net annual = $90,100.80.

Superannuation guarantee is 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top of your salary. For $118,560, super = $14,227.20. The maximum contribution base is $270,830, so this applies fully. Use the [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) page for more.

## Fortnightly pay breakdown

Fortnightly pay is simply weekly pay × 2. For our $60/hour example:
- Gross fortnightly: $4,560
- Tax and Medicare per fortnight: approximately $1,094.58 (based on annual estimate divided by 26)
- Net fortnightly: $3,465.42
- Super paid on top: $547.20 per fortnight

## Award rates and casual loading

If you are covered by an award (e.g., Professional Employees Award), minimum rates are higher than the National Minimum Wage. The Fair Work Ombudsman updates pay guides each year. From 1 July 2026, award minimum wages increased by 4.75%. Casual employees receive a 25% loading on top of the base rate. For example, a casual management consultant under an award might have a base hourly rate of $35, then $43.75 with loading. Always check the [pay guides](/blog) for your specific classification.

## Summary

Management consultant salaries are typically above the national average. Use the formula hourly × 38 × 52 to estimate annual gross. Remember that super is paid on top, tax is deducted, and casual loading applies if applicable. For a personalised calculation, use the [timesheet](/) to enter your hourly rate and see the full breakdown including fortnightly, tax, and super.

*Disclaimer: This article provides estimates only. Always verify with official sources such as the Fair Work Ombudsman, Australian Bureau of Statistics, and Australian Taxation Office.*
